messages.subject: Peptide level analysis with label-free DDA data
parts:
Hi MSstats,

Is it possible to perform a peptide level analysis with DDA data? I've tried, but I'm pretty sure it's not working because there is only one "transition" for each peptide. Will you please take a look at the error message I get with this analysis?

Thanks,

Scott

Error message:

"Protein AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGAAGK sp|P55012|S12A2_MOUSE 2 precursor [M+1] 2 has only single transition, the simplied model is fitted"
"error : can't analyze AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGAAGK sp|P55012|S12A2_MOUSE 2 precursor [M+1] 2 for comparison."
"Finished a comparison for protein  AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGAAGK sp|P55012|S12A2_MOUSE 2 precursor [M+1] 2 ( 1  of  38349 )"

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Peptide level analysis with label-free DDA data
parts:
Hi Scott,

MSstats can do peptide level analysis.  I think that this error message is not for one transition. As the message said, the simple model will be fitted. With this error message, It is hard to know what exactly happen for you data. Could you send me the subset of data, (including protein named "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGAAGK sp|P55012|S12A2_MOUSE 2 precursor [M+1] 2") and msstats.log file? It will be helpful to know what exactly happen.

Thanks,

Meena
